title: Strange Loop Lab: A White-Box Laboratory for Self-Model and Consciousness-Indicator Research
description: Strange Loop Lab is a deterministic, non-neural TypeScript laboratory for studying self-models, second-order reliability estimates and consciousness-indicator mechanisms. The repository contains six opt-in engines (V0.1–V0.6), the browser laboratory, 100-seed validation harnesses, a 43,800-episode research record, an untouched V0.6 holdout on seeds 10001–10100, hardening experiments, figure generators, SHA-256 manifests and the manuscript source. Code is MIT licensed; the manuscript and figures are CC BY 4.0. No claim of phenomenal consciousness is made.
notes: Code: MIT. Manuscript and figures: CC BY 4.0. Includes raw per-seed JSON, SHA-256 manifests and holdout provenance. This software does not establish consciousness or subjective experience.
